content:
Ben (Recruiter): quick one — candidate Aria Kapoor (Sr ML Eng) has a competing offer. She0is asking for an alternative to a higher base: front-loaded equity (50% of first-year grant vesting at month 3) plus a modest start-date flexibility (start 3 weeks earlier). Current approved offer: base $160,000 + $20k sign-on + standard RS. Can we do an exception to front-load RS or offer an equivalent cash structure to close by COB? cc @Leah

Leah (Hiring Manager): Aria would unblock the model infra work. I prefer cash if legal / comp say RS acceleration is a no-go. Manager can cover part of sign-on from project ops.

Aisha (People Ops): Two tracks: 1) comp committee for RS acceleration (slow), or 2) one-time cash alternative (signing bonus or staggered payments) to mirror frontload economics. We need manager justification, comp approval on cash equivalent, finance on funding, and legal on any vesting/clawback.

Priya (Comp & Benefits): Policy: equity schedules are rarely accelerated; committee required. We can approve a cash-fronted alternative up to ~30% of the first-year grant value without committee, paid as a one-time bonus or split over 3 months, but it will be taxable. Need manager justification here.

Ben (Recruiter): candidate prefers equity for tax reasons but says cash works if it0is structured over 3 months net-of-tax. Also wants earlier start due to personal timing.

Jordan (Finance): Funding quick-check: hiring contingency can cover up to $25k here this quarter. If we do a 3-month staggered cash alternative, confirm exact amount and payment cadence.

Aisha (People Ops): Actions to close today:
- Leah: paste 1-2 sentence manager justification.
- Priya: confirm exact cash equivalent and cadence (one-time vs 3-month).
- Jordan: ACK funding and cap.
- Sam: confirm legal on vesting alternative language and any clawback if leaving early.
- Ben: send revised offer with chosen structure and get candidate sign-off.

Leah (Hiring Manager): Manager justification: Aria0has rare production ML + infra experience that lets us ship the feature set for Q4. Losing her forces a month of contractor spend and delays product milestones. Cash alternative is lower bureaucracy and preserves schedule.

Priya (Comp & Benefits): approve cash alternative: equivalent to 40% of one-year equity target approximated at $18,000, paid in three equal installments over the first 90 days (30/30/40 split to align with payroll cadence). Sign-on unchanged. Equity schedule remains standard; committee can revisit later. Candidate must accept that these payments are taxable and not equity.

Jordan (Finance): ACK funding: up to $18k available from hiring contingency. Please route the payroll schedule to finance for payment setup.

Sam (Legal): I'll add language: "Alternative Cash Equity Payment: In lieu of accelerated equity vesting, Redwood Inference will pay a one-time alternative cash payment totaling $18,000, payable in three installments across the first 90 days. This payment is compensation and does not change equity grants or schedules. If employee voluntarily leaves before 6 months, Redwood reserves the right to reclaim a prorated portion of unvested installments as set forth in a repayment addendum." No equity acceleration without committee.

Ben (Recruiter): Sending revised offer now with 3-installment cash alternative and earlier start option. Candidate said she'll take cash if we can show the 3-month net schedule. Will post signed doc when e-signed. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:

Aisha (People Ops): Logging as a comp exception (cash-in-lieu of equity) and creating reminders for payroll installments and a 6-month clawback review. Update this thread if anything changes.
